gaps.explanation: General Fund (Exhibit P p10, 7,672,707) and nonmajor (Exhibit O p9, 875,640) agree with Exhibit E (p4, printed p14). Street and Debt Service detail comes from Exhibit L (p8, budgetary basis) while Exhibit E is GAAP: Street budgetary revenue 2,297,395 - Other Financing Sources 21,806 = 2,275,589 vs Exhibit E 2,284,072 (8,483); Debt Service 1,103,486 + 15,347 + 491,869 + 25,377 = 1,636,079 vs Exhibit E 2,171,314 (535,235). 8,483 + 535,235 = 543,718 = gap. No detail fix.

General Fund (Exhibits Q-T pp11-14: 7,583,062 less transfers out 254,798 and capital contributions 289,283 recorded as other financing = 7,038,981) and nonmajor (833,411) agree with Exhibit E (p4). Exhibit L (p8, budgetary) prints Street Streets 1,022,379 + Capital Outlay 252,901 = 1,275,280 vs Exhibit E Street 1,285,326 (10,046), and prints all Debt Service Fund spending as 'Other Financing Uses' 2,374,878 (recorded as other financing) vs Exhibit E Debt Service Total Expenditures 2,382,100 (General Government 110,063 + Lease Payments 10,737 + Bond Payments 2,261,300). 10,046 + 2,382,100 = 2,392,146 = gap. No detail fix.

Exhibit E (p4) Transfers In 445,690 = Street 21,806 + Debt Service 237,374 + Other Governmental 186,510. Detail has Capital Project Transfers In 186,510 (Exhibit O p9). Street and Debt Service detail is Exhibit L (p8, budgetary), which prints no transfer lines: Street 'Other Financing Sources' 21,806 and Debt Service 'Other Financing Sources' 813,851 (recorded under those labels). 21,806 + 237,374 = 259,180 = gap. No detail fix.

Exhibit E (p4) Transfers Out 445,690 = General 254,797 + Street 190,893. Detail General Fund Transfers Out pp11-14 = 32,306 + 85,000 + 10,000 + 127,492 = 254,798 (1 rounding). Street detail is Exhibit L (p8, budgetary), which prints the same 190,893 as 'Other Financing Uses' (recorded under that label, not as a transfer). 254,798 + 190,893 = 445,691 (1 rounding). No detail fix.
